entities.summary: Richard Joseph Gagnon is a Canadian Catholic retired prelate who served as Archbishop of Winnipeg from 2014 until 2024. He was President of the Canadian Conference of Catholic Bishops (CCCB) from 2019 to 2021, and previously served as the Bishop of Victoria.
